$comment: Components exported by ui-react that are intentionally NOT storied. Each entry must have a justification here. The coverage gate (scripts/check-story-coverage.mts) fails if an entry no longer matches any export, so this list can't hide stale entries.

reasons.ShellDocumentTitle: Sets the browser tab's title and renders nothing on the page; ShellPage's and WizardFrame's stories set one.
reasons.ShellScope: A context provider with no output of its own; its effect shows in the components that read it (InfoHint, FactList).
reasons.SharedTagsProvider: A context provider with no output of its own; it carries the tags picked across a page's catalogs, which show in CatalogFilters' Tags facet.
reasons.TagVocabularyProvider: A context provider with no output of its own; it collects the tags in use, which show as TagsField's suggestions (see its stories).
